title: Advance Special Topics Design Studio; Architecture Design Studio
description:
Cross-listed with ARCH408. Credit only granted for ARCH408 or ARCH608.

The Anacostia Aviary studio challenges students to design an aviary that fosters novel encounters and relationships between people and birds endemic to the Anacostia River watershed. This 6-week studio will be runentirely online, and will include case study analysis of aviaries, birdwatching towers, and blinds; discussion/readings from the fields of design and human-animal studies; individual aviary design projects; virtual pin-ups; and a virtual final review.
